One observed period or change, traceable to the rows that support it.

``observed`` holds values read directly from supporting rows; ``derived``

EvidenceView.description:
Facts, inferences and recommendations kept apart (spec §8): OBSERVED_FACT from the log (Phase 2/3 via Phase 6),

Document facts need Phase 7 retrieval, which is not exposed: NOT_AVAILABLE.

post.description:
Upload a log (raw CSV body, not multipart: nothing is spooled to disk) and start a case. The data is analysed
as UNVALIDATED. Runs the Phase 2 data-quality check immediately.

parameters.description: what you say this file is: stored and shown as 'declared by uploader, not verified'; it never changes the evidence class (always UNVALIDATED for uploads) or the Phase 5 scope
parameters.name: declared_evidence

schema.description: what you say this file is: stored and shown as 'declared by uploader, not verified'; it never changes the evidence class (always UNVALIDATED for uploads) or the Phase 5 scope
schema.title: Declared Evidence

post.description: Start a case from a bundled, labelled ColdSense SIMULATED sample (a server-side file; no visitor data).
Phase 3 event segmentation (+ Stage 2: Phase 6 diagnosis) with the limits you set; replaces the previous run.

Technician copilot: the server gate decides. While disabled no LLM provider is constructed, no LLM is called
and no tool runs, even for a direct API request.
Create a PENDING draft from the technician's own statement. A draft is not history; it writes no record.
Cancel a PENDING draft. Nothing is appended to the Phase 8 store and no report content changes.
Explicit user confirmation with the single-use token from the draft. This is the only route that appends.

get.description: Drafts, confirmed findings and their outcome state. Read-only; nothing is written by this route.

schema.title: Response Get Prediction Api V1 Cases  Case Id  Prediction Get

post.description: Phase 4 forecast (+ Phase 5 reliability). A refusal is a normal 200 result with ``outcome: REFUSED``.

schema.title: Response Create Prediction Api V1 Cases  Case Id  Prediction Post

post.description: Compose the report with the Phase 8 builder from confirmed records only; the numeric check can refuse it.

get.description: Usable readings split at Phase 3 data gaps, with the Phase 3 events. Needs POST .../analysis first.
Read-only: no server state. Sets (or keeps) the ``cs_csrf`` nonce cookie and returns its token.
The Copilot state comes from the server-side gate; the frontend never decides it.

Read-only Phase 7 retrieval over the local SQLite knowledge store.

The retrieval is deliberately separate from diagnosis: a quoted manual passage never changes a refusal or a
finding. If the index is missing the response is a clear ``NOT_AVAILABLE`` result, not a 500.
